member.summary:
Performs an UPSERT using SQLite's "INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(...) DO UPDATE" syntax.
You specify:
: all columns to insert (and available for update).
: the UNIQUE/PK columns that define the conflict target.
: which columns should be updated on conflict (defaults to all non-conflict columns).
Requires SQLite 3.24+ (supported by modern Microsoft.Data.Sqlite builds).
member.param: Columns that define the conflict target (must have UNIQUE or PK constraint).
Optional list of columns to update on conflict. If null/empty, updates all columns except conflict columns.
member.returns: Rows affected (SQLite returns 1 for insert, 1 for update in most cases).
